reading.body:
Global DC OY is a plausible but unconfirmed Finnish data-center business, with no verified capacity, operator, or operating status.

The record is an OpenStreetMap entry tagged telecom=data_center, located at 60.63 north, 25.26 east, roughly 24 miles from Helsinki Vantaa Airport. The name carries two signals: "OY" is the standard Finnish suffix for a limited company, and "DC" plausibly abbreviates data center. That is the whole of the evidence. No website, operator, or Finnish business registration was confirmed.

For AI infrastructure, the useful fact is the location, not the company. Southern Finland sits among the densest data-center clusters in Europe, drawn by cool climate, cheap power, and good fiber links to the Baltic and beyond. A facility this close to Helsinki is in the right place for that pattern. But the data records zero megawatts, so it says nothing about whether this site draws meaningful power, and power is what separates a real compute facility from a small colocation closet.

What the record does not tell the reader is whether Global DC OY operates at all, what it hosts, or how large it is. The research status is exhausted, meaning the search budget ran out before confirmation, not that the company was found lacking. Treat this as a lead to verify against Finnish corporate records, not as a confirmed node in any compute map.
